conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’ve been trying to activate my new credit card for hours! It’s not working, do it now!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the delay, sir. Can you confirm the last four digits of your card so I can check the activation status?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s seven eight, nine zero. I followed all the steps, but it’s still not active!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you. It seems the activation request didn’t process. I’ll activate it manually now. Please wait a moment.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hurry up! I need to use it today!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s done, sir. Your card is active now. You can use it immediately. Would you like me to send a confirmation?
